In Re: An application for anticipatory bail under Section 482

 with Patashpur Police Station Case No. 208 of 2024 dated
 23.03.2024 under Sections 498A/304B/34 of Ipc.

And
 In Re: Bharati Das.
 ...... Petit
 Mr. Tapon Dutta Gupta,
 Mr. Bhaskar Hutait.

... ... for the petitione
 Mr. Sandip Chakrabarty,
 Mr. Akash Ganguly.
 ... ... for the State
 1.
Petitioner is the mother-in-law of the victim lady.
She contends she has been falsely implicated.
Accordingly, she prays for anticipatory bail.
2. Learned Advocate for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail.
3. We have considered the materials on record.
Victim lady committed suicide five years after marriage.
Allegation against the petitioner i.e. mother-in-law are general and omnibus.
Co- accused have been released on regular bail.
Investigation is complete.
There is no chance of abscondence.
4. Under such circumstances, we are inclined to grant anticipatory bail.

5. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner viz., Bharati Das be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-, with two sureties of like amount each, to Signed By :
SOURAV GHOSH High Court of Calcutta 9 th of January 2025 05:05:43 PM the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
